description: The owed-smoke sweep's durable artifact — one entry per runnable browser-verification item. Walked by scripts/smoke-sweep.mjs via scripts/live-smoke.mjs (the execution primitive). Append new entries as future epics ship browser-testable stories, instead of leaving an 'owed to Daniel' line in a retro to go stale. See Roadmap/LEARNINGS.md and skills/live-smoke/SKILL.md for the categorization rationale (A=unauthed prod/staging, B=authed-local, C=Stripe money-path, D=MercadoPago-blocked, E=irreducible, F=stale). e2e/smoke-sweep-manifest.spec.ts guards this file: every e2e/*.browser.spec.ts must appear here or in "excluded" with a reason, every "file" must exist, and every "path" must resolve without a redirect.

entries.note: test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' }) — a failure here ABORTS the rest of the file and CI logs it 'did not run', which reads as green-by-skip. Read the run, not the exit code.
epic: one-landing-per-market; the / <-> /en client hop. Sets locale per-describe, so it needs a real browser — the api suite sees a 200 and learns nothing.
epic: root-shop-builder-home; the buyer link's position on / is a rendered fact.
platform-migrations S3, no committed spec beyond the api-level SEO spec
epic: admin-consolidation; no committed spec, ad-hoc render check
epic: admin-flags-cleanup; no committed spec, ad-hoc render check
epic: platform-migrations S3 admin-pricing fix; already proven working manually this session
epic: delivery-money-polish; needs a local Medusa backend + MS_TEST_SHIPPABLE_LISTING_ID
epic: home-dynamic-rows-restore; anonymous half also passes on prod, the signed-in half is why this is B
epic: order-comms-chain; needs MS_TEST_SELLER_EMAIL to own at least two visible orders or the mixed-row test skips itself

requirements._: Names a manifest entry may list in "requires". Each is probed once per run by scripts/smoke-sweep.mjs (PROBES) BEFORE anything executes; an entry whose requirement is unavailable is reported UNAVAILABLE and not run, and the sweep exits 2. Adding a name here means adding a probe there — an unknown name is fatal, never assumed satisfied.
requirements.seller-shop-fixture: The dev Clerk seller must OWN a marketplace_shops row — `qa-playwright-fixture`, created 2026-08-20 (the INSERT is in e2e/README.md). Without it every /shop/manage/* page 404s before rendering and reports as missing selectors, which reads exactly like a broken seller portal. Probed by slug against Supabase; an unreachable Supabase reports as unavailable, never as a missing fixture.
requirements.medusa-local: A local Medusa on :9000. Every /shop/manage/* surface calls getMySeller() against MEDUSA_STORE_URL; with nothing listening the whole seller portal fetch-fails and its specs report missing selectors that read exactly like regressions.

excluded._: spec file (e2e/<name>.browser.spec.ts) -> why it is deliberately NOT swept. The coverage guard bans an unlisted spec; this is the negation, so recording a real reason is always available and the guard never has to be bypassed.
excluded.e2e/cuenta-menu-popover.browser.spec.ts: DOM-isolated native Popover regression fixture: it verifies browser platform semantics, not a routable product surface for the URL smoke sweep.
